body: rebased & open for review now that #117451 has been merged.

I completely agree with your proposed shape for the way constants and enums are expressed.

`Variant` also already exposes its constants in your proposed shape, with `int` and the rest of `Variant` constants being exposed together, without enum values:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/f5af32893ba3774235b5d3c570d8433d079a4b82/core/variant/variant_call.cpp#L1656-L1668
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/f5af32893ba3774235b5d3c570d8433d079a4b82/core/variant/variant_call.cpp#L1712-L1729

From looking at those methods' callers, it looks to me like GDExtension and GDScript both already support the desired interface, and would require minimal changes under the hood to fit the proposed shape as applied to `Object` types. 

The only compatibility-breaking issue arises with exposed `ClassDB` methods, which are unfortunately named `ClassDB::get/has_integer_constant()`.

In my opinion, it would be worth doing this refactoring in 2 steps: a compatibility-preserving one and a compatibility-breaking one.
#### Compatibility-preserving
1. Have `GDType` store `int_constant_map` (renamed from `constant_map`), `constant_map` (called `variant_constant_map` in this current PR), and `enum_map` all separately. Both `int_constant_map` and `variant_constant_map` would be `AHashMap<StringName, Variant>`.
2. No longer store enum cases in `int_constant_map`, just `int`-typed constants.
3. Add a `GDType::get_constant_map()` method which would return the `constant_map`.
4. Add a `GDType::bind_enum_case()` which would handle enum cases.
5. Refactor `GDType::bind_integer_constant()` into `GDType::bind_constant()`, which would only be used to bind constants (not enum cases), and would duplicate it in `int_constant_map` if the `Variant`'s type is `Type::INT`.
6. Use a combination of `GDType::get_integer_constant_map()` and `GDType::get_enum_map()` (in the same way `Variant` does) in `ClassDB` for the exposed methods. If performance is a concern, we could add a temporary `AHashMap<String, int> enum_cases_map` in `GDType` and expose a getter. 
7. Use the new `GDType::get_constant_map()` for everything else that was changed in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/113586 (none of them need the `int` specification; they can all handle `Variant` being given instead, with any type).

#### Compatibility-breaking (Godot 5.0)
1. Replace the `ClassDB` integer-based methods with `Variant` based ones.
2. Remove `int_constant_map` and remove the `GDType::get_integer_constant()`.

This way, we don't need to wait for a compatibility break for a majority of the work at the `GDType` level.
We can also slowly change over internals from using `ClassDB` to using the new interface on `GDType` directly before the compat-breaking changes come, allowing us to do it step-by-step instead of needing to do it all at once. This should make the work much more manageable and reviews a lot easier.
